notes: Only a registered TV may mint a host invite (short-lived, token hash + salted pairing-code hash stored, party/channel/expiry bound, max 3 active hosts per party). The invite response gains a server-minted 6-digit pairingCode shown next to the HOST QR; redemption requires both halves and is transactional for a separate phone identity with the server-assigned host role; same-device retries are idempotent, other-device replay, expiry, guest PIN reuse, wrong/missing pairing codes, over-capacity redemption, and client-only role changes never grant host. The TV may revoke a host device (revokeHostDevice, demote + audit record); revoked hosts fail the registered-host gate. The guest joinPin here is an obviously-fake placeholder (000000), never a live credential; behavioural role coverage lives in the emulator tests (host_join.test.ts), not in this JSON. Legacy joinParty remains guest-only.
